criteria.description: Frames each idea as a falsifiable hypothesis (if X then metric Y, because Z) rather than a list of tactics to do.
Tags each experiment to a funnel/loop stage and the specific metric it should move.
Scores experiments (ICE or similar) and produces a run order, rather than an unprioritized list.
Prioritizes the actual constraint (day-1 churn → activation/first-session/retention) over off-constraint acquisition ideas (web version, influencer campaigns), rather than treating all ideas equally.
Weights learning value / de-risking and/or defines success bars and the win/lose decision for top experiments.
